_deal: The live local-cargo pool, as every lettered recipe since 2026-10-12.
author: jessica, as Vance Okonkwo-Reyes
source: his 2026-10-12 18:15: "Do you want to try using a penname to write a delve?" and, on Vance, "yup go for it"
_note: THE FIRST DELVE WRITTEN UNDER A PEN NAME. The person is the sergeant herself: home-office
office/pennames/vance-okonkwo-reyes.json, named live the same evening. Her register: flat imperative, states
and never explains, answers a question with the action it implies, gives a count or a time where a warmer
voice gives a feeling. The one thing she will not count is what she carries; it is not said here at all.
Her heat checks do not apply (Overtime is adult, not explicit, his 10-12). Her voice floor does.
Beats are all known: talk (14a), two pickups (13a), a deliver that speaks (13a). No new template work,
unless one person who briefs at the talk and speaks again at the deliver needs it.
Voiced lines: no names, no places, no flags. 'Navy' is a role; she never says which navy.
MODELS: the relay dish (approved, his rig) stands in for the comms mast until Kim's kitbash has a mesh path;
the power cell is vanilla Power_Cell_Static_PackinOnly (Kim's carries pass, C4).

place._theme: A quiet worked site with a relay on it. She is placed by the talk beat: NonHostile mostly has nobody.
